translationRepairs: On renchen day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs and promoted yuyue; Yelü Li, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Telidi was made administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Shiqian was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.

On renchen day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs and promoted yuyue; Yelü Mu, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Telidi was made administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Shiqian was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.
s0006 names 耶律霂; 霂 is Mu, so replacing the false given name Li is required and the rest of the sentence is unchanged.
That month the jinshi Liu Jin and one hundred thirteen others were passed.
That month the jinshi Liu Guan and one hundred thirteen others were passed.
s0013 names the jinshi 劉瓘; 瓘 is Guan, not Jin, so the idiomatic personal name must be corrected.
That month the jinshi Liu Jin and one hundred thirteen others were passed.
That month the jinshi Liu Guan and one hundred thirteen others were passed.
The same unit’s literal field also reads 劉瓘 as Liu Jin; Guan matches the Chinese given name.
On guimao day Nanjing refugees' corvée was remitted for three years; households that had suffered fire were exempt from rent and tax for one year.
On guiwei day Nanjing refugees' corvée was remitted for three years; households that had suffered fire were exempt from rent and tax for one year.
s0024 begins 癸未; that sexagenary day is guiwei, whereas guimao would be 癸卯.
On guimao day Nanjing refugees' corvée was remitted for three years; households that had suffered fire were exempt from rent and tax for one year.
On guiwei day Nanjing refugees' corvée was remitted for three years; households that had suffered fire were exempt from rent and tax for one year.
Literal likewise mistook 癸未 for guimao; guiwei is the correct day name.
On xinmao day Yelü Yixin was dismissed as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
On xinmao day Yelü Yixin was sent out as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
出知興中府事 records an outward appointment to administer Xingzhong, not dismissal from that prefectural post.
On xinmao day Yelü Yixin was dismissed as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
On xinmao day Yelü Yixin was sent out as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
Literal shares the same error on 出知; “sent out as administrator” restores the appointment sense.
On guimao day six drum-and-banner zhala guards were established to protect imperial grandson Prince of Liang Yanxi.
On guiwei day six drum-and-banner zhala guards were established to protect imperial grandson Prince of Liang Yanxi.
s0038 is dated 癸未; guiwei is correct and guimao is a different day (癸卯).
On guimao day six drum-and-banner zhala guards were established to protect imperial grandson Prince of Liang Yanxi.
On guiwei day six drum-and-banner zhala guards were established to protect imperial grandson Prince of Liang Yanxi.
Literal likewise needs guiwei for 癸未 rather than guimao.
On dingmao day Yelü Renjie was dismissed as military commissioner of Wuding Army.
On dingmao day Yelü Renjie was sent out as military commissioner of Wuding Army.
出為武定軍節度使 is an outward appointment as Wuding Army military commissioner, not dismissal from that office.
On dingmao day Yelü Renjie was dismissed as military commissioner of Wuding Army.
On dingmao day Yelü Renjie was sent out as military commissioner of Wuding Army.
Literal repeats the false “dismissed” reading of 出為; “sent out as” matches the Chinese.

On jiazi day of the sixth month an edict ordered monthly sacrifice at Guande Hall; on Cold Food each year, on birthdays and death days while emperors lived, proceed to Jingzong's imperial portrait hall to offer sacrifice.

On jiazi day of the sixth month an edict ordered monthly sacrifice at Guande Hall; each year on the Cold Food festival and on the birthdays and death anniversaries of the various emperors, proceed to Jingzong's imperial portrait hall to offer sacrifice.
諸帝在時生辰及忌日 means the various emperors’ lifetime birthdays and death anniversaries, not rites held “while emperors lived.”
That month an edict ordered use of the bushel and peck Taixing had fixed.
That month an edict ordered use of the sheng and dou measures fixed by the millet standard.
黍所定升斗 are sheng and dou measures fixed by the millet standard; “Taixing” invents a person absent from the Chinese.
That month, edict ordered use of the bushel and peck Taixing had fixed.
That month, edict ordered use of the sheng and dou measures fixed by the millet standard.
Literal invents the same nonexistent Taixing; millet-standard sheng and dou restore 黍所定升斗.
On yimao day of the tenth winter month an edict ordered Huage to tutor Prince of Liang Yanxi; Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant was promoted grand general.
On yimao day of the tenth winter month an edict ordered Huage to tutor Prince of Liang Yanxi and promoted him Grand General of the Jinwu Guard.
加金吾衛大將軍 does promote Huage, but 金吾衛 is the Jinwu Guard, not a “Golden Crow Guard”; keep the promotion on Huage with the correct office name.
On wushen day Privy Council academician Du Gongyu was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
On wushen day Privy Council academician Du Gongwei was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
s0151 names 杜公謂; 謂 is wei, so Gongwei replaces the false Gongyu.
On wushen day Privy Council academician Du Gongyu Associate Administrator of Affairs.
On wushen day Privy Council academician Du Gongwei Associate Administrator of Affairs.
Literal shares the Gongyu misreading of 公謂; Gongwei is required.

On guichou day envoys were dispatched to promote supreme commander Xiao Eduwo to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, deputy general Laogu Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general, Xiao Yage military commissioner of Jingjiang Army, Yelü Yannu Right Defender of the Gate Commandant grand general, and still bestow rewards on the troops.

On guichou day envoys were dispatched to promote supreme commander Xiao Eduwo to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, deputy general Laogu to Grand General of the Jinwu Guard, Xiao Yage to military commissioner of Jingjiang Army, and Yelü Yannu to Grand General of the Right Gate Guard, and also to bestow rewards on the troops.
裨將老古金吾衛大將軍 separates personal name Laogu from Grand General of the Jinwu Guard; “Golden Crow” and “Laogu Defender” misparse the office.

On guichou day dispatched envoys to promote supreme commander Xiao Eduwo to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, deputy general Laogu Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general, Xiao Yage military commissioner of Jingjiang Army, Yelü Yannu Right Defender of the Gate Commandant grand general, and still bestow rewards on the troops.

On guichou day dispatched envoys to promote supreme commander Xiao Eduwo to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, deputy general Laogu to Grand General of the Jinwu Guard, Xiao Yage to military commissioner of Jingjiang Army, and Yelü Yannu to Grand General of the Right Gate Guard, and also to bestow rewards on the troops.
Literal needs the same Jinwu Guard reading of 金吾衛 and must not fuse personal name 老古 into the following office title.
On wuyin day Chancellor Liang Ying was dismissed as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
On wuyin day Chancellor Liang Ying was sent out as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
宰相梁穎出知興中府事 sends Liang Ying out to administer Xingzhong; “dismissed as” reverses the 出知 appointment.
On wuyin day Chancellor Liang Ying was dismissed as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
On wuyin day Chancellor Liang Ying was sent out as administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture.
Literal likewise misreads 出知 as dismissal from Xingzhong rather than an outward posting.

On dingsi day of the seventh autumn month Consort Hui's mother Lady Yan of Yan State Xiaogu, because sorcery against Prince of Liang was exposed, was executed; her son Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Chouwo was struck from the register and placed in a border commandery, still attached to Xing Sheng Palace.

On dingsi day of the seventh autumn month Consort Hui's mother Xiaogu, Lady of Yan State, because sorcery against Prince of Liang was exposed, was executed; her son Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Chouwo was struck from the register and placed in a border commandery, still attached to Xing Sheng Palace.
燕國夫人削古 is Xiaogu, Lady of Yan State; “Lady Yan of Yan State” wrongly doubles Yan as if a surname.

Autumn, seventh month, on dingsi day Consort Hui's mother Lady Yan of Yan State Xiaogu, because sorcery against Prince of Liang was exposed, was executed; her son Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Chouwo was struck from the register and placed in a border commandery, still attached to Xing Sheng Palace.

Autumn, seventh month, on dingsi day Consort Hui's mother Xiaogu, Lady of Yan State, because sorcery against Prince of Liang was exposed, was executed; her son Prince of Lanling Commandery Xiao Chouwo was struck from the register and placed in a border commandery, still attached to Xing Sheng Palace.
Literal has the same title/name parse for 燕國夫人削古; Xiaogu with Lady of Yan State is correct.
On guimao day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Qian, Xian, Cheng, and Yi prefectures.
On guiwei day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Qian, Xian, Cheng, and Yi prefectures.
s0208 is dated 癸未; guiwei is required, not guimao (癸卯).
On guimao day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Qian, Xian, Cheng, and Yi prefectures.
On guiwei day grain was issued to relieve poor people in Qian, Xian, Cheng, and Yi prefectures.
Literal also mistook 癸未 for guimao; guiwei matches the Chinese day.
